mandatory_groups.name: default-off-and-bound-admission
requirements: omitted and explicit off preserve previous machine behavior
bound admission reports the exact reviewed virtual words and digest
no numeric profile override

mandatory_groups.name: exact-source-cold-sequences
requirements: qcedev7/6 and qcrypto5/4 literal RMW order
both client orders share identities and independent pipe state
final EE mask (M0 & ~0xf0) | 0xa0
descriptor LO/4-bit HI/fifo0x9000/threshold0x10 exact reads
no MMIO in private inputs or physical device

mandatory_groups.name: strict-access-and-atomic-failures
requirements: 1/2/8 byte and unaligned access rejection
readonly identities and status; writeonly W1C
unsupported pipe/EE/control/register holes
reserved bits/stream/BAM2BAM/held-reset/invalid ring reject
before-after complete pure state equality
each single-MR aligned1/2/8-byte or unaligned4-byte operation produces exactly one matching device rejection diagnostic
qtest OK is protocol acknowledgement, not MEMTX success

mandatory_groups.name: no-submission-or-guest-output
requirements: each pipe EVNT_REG writes0/8/max all reject
QCE ordinary/QC/OEM GO and key/data/IV reject
complete descriptor/output/adjacent-RAM witnesses unchanged
zero completion status and IRQ; no claim of guest GIC route

mandatory_groups.name: reset-and-isolation
requirements: per-pipe assert/release clears only that pipe
EE global mask and other pipes retained
held-reset writes reject
system reset explicit reference initial state
no clock/timer/backend activity

mandatory_groups.name: pure-observation-and-migration
requirements: all own read-only getters repeated without MMIO/continue
complete248-byte payload source-to-target state equality
116-byte guard validates before mutable state load
profile0to1 and1to0 mismatch rejection
individual immutable-field corruption rejected
invalid pending/reset/feature/width/ring state rejected before IRQ update
complete stream bytes retained; no absent evidence inferred
normal processes acknowledge QMP quit and are drained and reaped without kill
expected fatal rejected loads retain pre-load pure snapshots, zero pre-load memory/MMIO/cont counts, exact diagnostic and nonzero exit, complete drain and reap
no post-exit observer value is fabricated; guard ordering claim is limited to this device payload

mandatory_groups.name: source-and-preservation
requirements: complete pinned public inputs and source-only generation/negative checks
base64-file tree/current actual source gate
previous107 complete normalized CI contracts retained in order
all five original native runners unchanged
natural push and PR full successfulCI then independent artifact review
